links.outcome: Diagnostic performance of commercial stroke AI on local prospective hospital data against registry reference
links.effect: AVIEW NeuroCAD: sensitivity 0.97, specificity 0.935, precision 0.788, accuracy 0.942. JBS-01K: sensitivity 0.98, specificity 0.795, precision 0.833, accuracy 0.89.
links.quote: JBS-01K achieved a sensitivity of 0.98, specificity of 0.795, precision of 0.833, and an accuracy of 0.89 for ischemic stroke detection.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial AI neuroimaging tools for ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke detection using hospital registry data, noting performance before and after clinician corrections.

primary.practice: clinician review and correction of AI outputs
